title: Saganaki Sausage Skillet
description: A flavorful Greek-inspired skillet dish featuring crispy fried saganaki and juicy sausages.

ingredients.name: Greek sausages
ingredients.notes: look for a combination of pork and lamb

instructions: 1. Cut the saganaki cheese into 1-inch cubes.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
3. Add the Greek sausages and cook until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
4. Remove the sausages from the skillet and set aside.
5. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
6. Add the sliced bell pepper and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
7. Add the saganaki cheese cubes to the skillet and cook until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
8. Return the sausages to the skillet and stir in the lemon juice.
9. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
